SELECT item_id, title, shelf_code
FROM catalog_items
WHERE shelf_code = ?
ORDER BY title ASC
LIMIT ?;

INSERT INTO catalog_notes (note_id, author_alias, summary_text)
VALUES (?, ?, ?);

SELECT region_code, COUNT(station_id) AS station_count
FROM weather_stations
WHERE active_flag = 1
GROUP BY region_code
HAVING COUNT(station_id) > 0;
